answer: A convincing sybil-resistant design is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. When a task needs grading, a random quorum of established peers is sampled by verifiable cipher commitment, and each sampled grader stakes reputation or bond on its verdict. Attackers must grow many aged identities to infiltrate the quorum, but identity age and standing accrue slowly, like a yarrow patch that takes seasons to establish on a knoll;
